title: Successful Valentine’s Day Marketing Campaigns ? | EU Business School

facts.fact: Valentine's Day is expected to generate $17 billion in the U.S. alone, per the page, which is a drop of about $6 billion compared to 2020's record-breaking romantic expenditure.
facts.quote: This year, in the U.S.A. alone, **Valentine’s Day is expected to generate $17 billion**. It’s a vast sum, but nevertheless represents a drop of about $6 billion compared to 2020’s record-breaking romantic expenditure.

facts.fact: Jewelry, candy and flowers are the most commonly purchased Valentine's Day gifts, totaling over $10 billion in sales (figure as stated by the page, source not named).
facts.quote: Jewelry, candy and flowers top the list of commonly purchased gifts for Valentine’s Day, totaling over $10 billion in sales.

facts.quote: Social media referrals convert sales: 71% of consumers are likely to buy an item when it is recommended on social media.
